title: Evaluation Suite v1
description: A frozen suite snapshot (ADR-0006 decision 1): an ordered, hash-pinned member list of evaluation cases. A suite is immutable once published; a revised membership is a new suite record. Suites carry no domain semantics.

description.description: Optional free-text description of the suite's purpose.

sha256.description: Mandatory content hash pinning the exact case record version.

cases.description: Pinned member list of evaluation cases. At least one; membership is exact because every member is hash-pinned.

frozen_at.description: Timestamp at which this suite snapshot was frozen.
